text_block_list.text:
...A few weeks after finishing the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn).

King Halo called me out today, so I came 
to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Long time no see. It's been a while since 
I came here, too.
choice_data_list: You came here the other day too, right?

You came here the other day too, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Geez! That's not what I mean!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
About a year ago, we were standing right 
here for a certain purpose, weren't we?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Here you are, Trainer. Are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The resolve to walk a path fit for a King, 
a truly first-rate journey true to who I 
am.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by that declaration a year ago, 
I began walking a path that belongs to me 
and me alone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Not to be recognized by someone else, but 
for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And even now, I continue to walk my path 
as a first-rate Umamusume."
choice_data_list: Count on me in the future too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, about that... Lately, there's been 
something really bugging me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is it, this—
(WAAAAAHHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The stands are already buzzing as she 
makes her entrance! As expected of this 
year's Classic champion!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey guys, aren't you getting a little 
carried away?
choice_data_list:
It was just as exciting when it was your 
turn, though.

It was just as exciting back when it was 
your turn.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~?! Then that's even worse, isn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The one who won the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, 
the Sprinters Stakes, AND the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) all in this single year... was 
none other than me, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm the star of this year!! I'm the one 
who should be at the center of everyone's 
attention! I'm the only one people should 
be worshipping!!
...In short.
choice_data_list: You mean you want more attention?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes. Not just "more"—it must be "always"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am King Halo! A first-rate 
Umamusume, and the one and only star of my 
world!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep walking down this path, 
the spotlight needs to be on me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're my juniors, I have zero 
intention of giving way!
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we keep on winning?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I shall show everyone a performance 
befitting a first-rate King—
(WAAAAAHHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! Why are you getting in King's way?! 
Stupid cheers, stupid, stupid~~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~... Urgh, no matter who the junior 
is, I'm definitely not gonna lose to 
them~...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, to start things off, let's see... 
maybe win the Arima Kinen or something—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Returning from Race
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, who do you think is gonna be 
this year's Horse Girl of the Year?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm super curious, super curious! And 
hey, who's going to be the Hall of Fame 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just thought of a great idea. And 
if I recall correctly...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. Did you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, my mother said she wants to 
design the racing outfit for a future URA 
Hall of Fame Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Still, isn't an achievement like that 
just a stepping stone on my path?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am a first-rate Umamusume 
worthy of becoming a world Hall of Fame 
Umamusume!!"

"Hall of Fame Umamusume." It is the title 
bestowed upon the Umamusume who 
contributed most to the Twinkle Series.

...It is considered the greatest honor 
bestowed upon a retired Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Guess I'll do my best until retirement~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Retirement!? Don't talk such 
nonsense!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
King will remain active for life! 
Honestly, don't say such absurd things!

...It seems King Halo has absolutely no 
intention of retiring.

"If that's the case, earning the title of 
Hall of Fame Umamusume would be far off in 
the future, but—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if I really should enter the 
Arima Kinen after all. Hmm... in that 
case."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Passing everyone from dead last? 'The 
King Who Makes the Impossible Possible.' 
Isn't the media headline just perfect...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, now that that's settled, it's 
time to train! We're practicing our final 
spurt!

—Without worrying about the distant 
future, I should focus on running in the 
"now" with her first.
